question: Which athlete received the Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year award in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simone Biles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simone Biles**, an American gymnast, received the Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year award in **2025**, recognizing her exceptional achievements in gymnastics.
 
• Biles is considered one of the **greatest gymnasts of all time**, having won multiple Olympic gold medals and numerous World Championship titles.
 
• The Laureus World Sports Awards are prestigious annual awards honoring the greatest athletes and teams across various sports disciplines globally.
 
• Simone Biles was recognized for her **remarkable performance** in the sport despite facing personal challenges, which inspired athletes and fans worldwide.
 
• This accolade highlights her **dedication, resilience, and unmatched skill** in gymnastics, making her a global icon for sports excellence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Simone Biles:**

 
 
• Born on **March 14, 1997**, in Columbus, Ohio, USA.
 
• Biles has won a record-breaking **25 World Championship medals**, including 19 golds, making her the most decorated gymnast in history.
 
• She is known for her innovative routines and has multiple moves named after her, such as the "Biles" on floor and vault.
 
• In addition to her athletic achievements, Biles has been an advocate for **mental health awareness**, openly discussing her challenges during the Tokyo Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• Established in **2000**, the awards celebrate the achievements of athletes across various sports disciplines.
 
• The Laureus Sportswoman of the Year award specifically honors the most outstanding female athlete based on performance and impact in the previous year.
 
• Winners are selected by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, comprising legendary athletes and sports personalities.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees for 2025:**
 
 
• **Iga Świątek:** Polish tennis player and winner of multiple Grand Slam titles.
 
• **Naomi Osaka:** Japanese tennis player recognized for her dominance in women's tennis and advocacy for mental health.
 
• **A’ja Wilson:** American basketball player known for her stellar performances in the WNBA.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Simone Biles:**
 
 
• Her achievements have contributed significantly to the popularity and visibility of gymnastics worldwide.
 
• Biles serves as a role model for athletes, emphasizing the importance of **perseverance, self-care, and excellence**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Simone Biles' Achievements:**

 
 
• She has won **7 Olympic medals**, including 4 golds, 1 silver, and 2 bronzes.
 
• Known for her difficulty and execution in routines, she has revolutionized gymnastics with her innovative techniques.
 
• Biles' advocacy for **mental health** has sparked discussions about athlete well-being and resilience.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Laureus Awards:**
 
 
• These awards are regarded as the "Oscars" of sports, celebrating excellence and inspiring future generations.
 
• Past winners include iconic athletes such as **Serena Williams, Usain Bolt, and Roger Federer**.
 
• They recognize not only performance but also the impact athletes have on society through their platform.
